title: Burden-weighted prioritisation of READS/TARGETS (not drugs)
method: score = w_B*B + w_U*U + w_D*D over cited 1..5 tiers; deterministic sort by score, tie-break by gamma-|h_sp| then gene name.
label: This is a prioritisation of TARGETS/READS, NOT a ranking of drugs, doses, or efficacy.
firewall_note: gamma-|h_sp| is shown as the structural read's place in the map and is NOT folded into the clinical priority score (it is a promoter-stiffness read, not a clinical magnitude).
